summary.value: The charming Teemto Pagalies is popular everywhere except his own homeworld, from which he was outcast. The Veknoid doesn't complain. He's got all the fans he needs cheering for him on the track.

description.value: Teemto Pagalies' IPG-X1131 LongTail features a unique circular shape. The internal cycling ring functions as a gyroscopic stabilizer, allowing it to keep up with more aerodynamic podracers. But what improvements the cycling ring grants in cornering, it sacrifices in speed.
Afterburner power is increased and Cornering maneuverability improved.
